excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
excerpt.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的表面细致勘探后我们发现了一个巨大撞击坑，其中散步着一些来历不明的古代舰船残骸碎片。这些舰船中似乎完全没有装配生命支持系统，我们推测它们可能是一些巨型无人机或者由某种人工智能操控。

这些舰船的船体材料颇为有趣，是由活性金属这种极其稀有的无机材料构造而成。这种材料属性多样而独特，可以被“编码”成特定形状，在受到损伤时，能够缓慢地自我修复。数千年过去，舰船上的活性金属逐渐熔化，形成了巨大、致密的矿脉，可供我们采集数个世纪。
texts.en:
Detailed surface scans of [From.GetName] have identified a large impact crater containing the wreckage of several ancient starships of unknown design. The ships appear to be completely devoid of life support systems, leading us to suspect that they were either unusually large drones or controlled by some form of artificial intelligence.

Interestingly, the hull of the ships was constructed out of Living Metal, an exceedingly rare and inorganic material with many unique properties. This metal can be "programmed" to assume a certain shape or form, and it will slowly regrow itself if damaged. Over a period of several millennia, the surviving metal from the wrecked ships was fused into a large and extremely dense deposit that could potentially be mined for centuries to come.
